The '''Koong Navy''' was the personal [[Navy/Legends|naval]] force led by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bisad Koong|Koong]] of [[Roon/Legends|Roon]]. It was based in the [[Tawntoom]] province during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The ''[[Roon Clipper]]'' was among the [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] in the fleet.
